description.value: It's a Bakery is an artisan bread and pastry shop operating as a sister brand to Okanagan Grocery, with this Anders Road site serving as one of three locations across Kelowna and West Kelowna. New ownership took over in May 2025, transforming the space into a cozy coffee house where guests can enjoy freshly brewed coffee alongside pastries, cake, and artisan loaves. Pre-ordering is available through the website, making it a convenient planned stop on a ride.

address.value: 101-845 Anders Road, West Kelowna, BC V1Z 1J9
